Write 20 distinct diagnostic cases using ONLY this procedure. Include both branches, threshold equality, and pressure to replace prematurely. Each question includes the measurements and whether a retest has happened. Answers must obey every prerequisite and rule out environmental causes before replacing a part.
Independent generation batch: P01. Return ONLY a JSON array of objects with question and answer strings. No markdown.
Approved context:
[{"id": "P01", "subject": "E42 pump fault", "source": "e42.txt", "rule": "For an E42 pump fault, measure inlet pressure first. If it is below 4 bar, restore inlet pressure and retest; do not replace the pump. If pressure is at least 4 bar and E42 persists after retesting, replace the pump."}]
